parameters.site_description: A portable command-line foundation for a calmer workstation.

hero.title: Carry the useful parts of your shell without carrying the clutter.
hero.description: Mantle provides explicit, cross-platform commands and conventions that stay understandable on macOS, Linux, and development containers.

features.title: Keep workstation behavior small and understandable.
features.description: Portable defaults stay explicit while environment-specific ownership remains separate.

items.title: POSIX-first behavior
items.description: Prefer stable shell behavior and isolate Bash, Zsh, Fish, macOS, and Linux differences.

items.title: Discoverable commands
items.description: Use named commands and long-lived conventions instead of invisible startup magic.

items.title: Works with Realm
items.description: Keep host utilities separate from reproducible development-environment ownership.

useCases.title: A small layer for recurring workstation work.
useCases.description: Adopt only the commands needed by the current machine.

items.title: New workstation
items.description: Restore a reviewable baseline without copying an entire home directory.

items.title: Development container
items.description: Expose familiar helpers while Realm owns the container image and lifecycle.

code.title: Start with one explicit command.
code.description: The installer reports what it changes and keeps shell-specific behavior bounded.

trust.title: Read the source before it touches the shell.
trust.description: Mantle keeps installation, compatibility, security, and license information close to the repository.

finalCta.title: Make the workstation easier to explain.
finalCta.description: Review the install contract, choose the modules you need, and keep the rest out.

footer.summary: Portable commands and shell conventions for calmer development environments.
